fusions.name: Lancing Claw
fusions.desc: Claws an enemy that carries one of your afflictions for 8 damage, using up that affliction and stripping 5% of its armour for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Bitter Spit
fusions.desc: Hisses a glob of bitter spit at the first enemy in line for 4 damage, with a 35% chance to leave it [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Licked Clean
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 poison conditions from you and restores 10 health.

fusions.name: Acquired Taste
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%. Your poison resistance rises by 15%.
